digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: The event store lacks an aggregation layer to derive agent-driven dev loop trends over time and lacks durable instrumentation for three tier-C blindspots: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (which prior change caused a bug), and bug outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky)

A single `rebar metrics` command with dynamic date-range filtering must surface every available metric across three lenses (agent loop health, codebase decay, gate economics) with no missing keys in output (values or structured unavailable state)

Tier-C signals must be captured passively without agent self-report: env/integration-diagnosis via ERROR gate-sidecar outcomes, bug provenance via best-effort blame-derived `caused_by` links (skipped when ambiguous), bug classification via persisted `--class` enum on close
Bug-close friction must remain flat: the required free-text `--reason` is replaced (not supplemented) by a bounded `--class` enum, keeping required bug-specific argument count at exactly one

Auto-derived `caused_by` edges bypass the closed-source guard and blame the pre-fix parent commit over the file_impact of the bug, never the fixing commit, and feed only classified-confidence (non-authoritative) metrics

All backfilled/classified values carry `source=backfill_classified` and `confidence=classified`, and `is_authoritative()` returns False so they are never aggregated into authoritative structural series
